items.label: Freestanding Structure
items.value: With a sturdy iron wire frame sewn into the top edges, simply stretch the dirty clothes hamper out and it will stand upright on its own. For stability, please ensure the hamper remains upright without placing any clothes on the edge and place clothes evenly within the hamper to maintain balance and keep it from collapsing.

items.label: Ultra Large
items.value: The laundry hamper measures 15.7 x 11.8 x 26.4 inches (L x W x H) with a capacity of 80L and 2 of set which easily contains 1.5x2 loads of laundry. It can hold a lot of items such as dirty clothes, wet towels, sheets, etc.

items.label: Reinforced Handles
items.value: The 2 handles are reinforced with strong stitching and are long enough for carring with 1 or 2 hands. While full of items, our large hampers for laundry can also be easily carried up and down stairs or to a laundromat with ease.

items.label: Premium Material
items.value: The foldable clothes basket is made from thick polyester and primuin cotton. The interior features PE waterproof coating can keep stored items dry. Simply use a wet cloth to wipe off the dirt. Do not clean it in washing machine and dryer, as doing so may damage the leakproof PE coating.

items.label: Collapsible Design
items.value: Our laundry hampers for bedroom can be easily folded into 1 piece for a save space storage when not in use. It is ideal for laundry room, bedroom, bathroom, closet and even for college dorms, travel, rv, campers, hotel use and shopping.
